rationale: A rising major arpeggio says the kettle is awake; a two-tone rising fourth closes the boil (the UX contract asks for a two-tone done chime); the overheat warning is a repeated single high pitch with gaps so it reads as urgent and never resolves; the press click is one very short high tick inside the 300 ms confirm budget. All pitches sit in the piezo band c5..c8.

transducer.part: illustrative 12 mm piezo curve; replace with the chosen part's datasheet

listening.rationale: Kitchen at night with the heater off, user one metre away; illustrative until measured per ISO 24501 Annex A/B.
